definitions.general_C: Existing broad #C from counters.function_calls; all detected tool/function calls.
definitions.skill_call_evidence_count: Chosen narrow injected-skill count: unique sync-check-record JSONL entries for integrity-sync/performance-audit in main output and follow-up logs only.

definitions.slash_skill_mentions: Literal /integrity-sync or /performance-audit mentions in main/follow-up logs; noisy auxiliary only.
